notes: Adds a one-time first-run Create Administrator flow for fresh ArmoryGrid deployments instead of presenting an unusable login screen.
Uses backend setupRequired state so the same flow works in Docker and the Windows packaged build whenever the users table is empty.
Creates the first account atomically as Admin, signs it in immediately, and permanently closes anonymous setup after the first account exists.
Adds username/password confirmation and password-strength feedback while preserving normal login behavior for existing deployments.
